fixes.problem: The hero photo is drawn as a dotted, halftone-like green pattern with a blurry glass bubble. The real screen shows a photo of white and yellow wildflowers under a sharp glass sphere. This is the biggest visible difference on the screens (SSIM 0.676).
fixes.fix: Remove the CSS gradient and dot pattern. Draw the real photo for the top ~480px of the screen: gray sky at the top, a wildflower meadow from y≈290 down, and a fade to #FDFCFA at the bottom. Keep the sphere at about x113–299, y120–318 with its bright top highlight and a crisp edge. Draw the computer icon inside it in light gray with a white outline. Use a listed picture only if one exists for s07. None is listed, so match it with a smoother gradient and no dot texture.

fixes.problem: The title and body text are wrong. The real 'Welcome to Computer' is slightly smaller and narrower (line 1 spans about x128–283). The mock's is bigger and wider (x124–287). The body text wraps differently: the real one breaks after 'Computer,' and the mock breaks after 'of'.
fixes.fix: Reduce the serif title font size by about 3% and set the line height to about 48px. Set the body text to 14px with a max-width of about 350px so it wraps as 'You have access to a limited preview of Computer, your' / 'always-on teammate that works for you.' Keep the color #6B6B6B.

fixes.problem: The sheet text is a little too heavy and wide. The heading is wider than the real one (x51–361 vs x53–359). The list row 'Work across all your connected apps and tools' runs to x393, where the real one ends at x372. The 'LIMITED PREVIEW' pill text is also off.
fixes.fix: Set the list text to 15px regular weight with letter-spacing of about -0.1px, so row 2 ends near x372. Reduce the heading size by about 1.5%. Shrink the pill text to about 11px with slightly wider letter-spacing. Make the 'Get started' label 16px medium, centered at y790 (the mock draws it at 789).

fixes.problem: The prompt card's inner text is misaligned. 'Computer researches…' sits about 1px off, the bold 'researches' is heavier, and the 'Computer' chip label is shifted right (x99 vs x97).
fixes.fix: Set the card text to 12.5px with 'researches' at weight 500. Shift the chip's inner icon and label left by about 2px. Keep the card at x33–378, y339–432.

fixes.problem: The 'Ask anything…' placeholder and the 'Model' pill differ. The Model pill is about 4px taller in the mock, and its label sits slightly off. The placeholder renders a little wider.
fixes.fix: Set the Model pill height to about 30px (y775–805) with the label centered, weight 400, 14px. Set the placeholder to 16px with letter-spacing about -0.1px, color #6B6B6B. Make the incognito icon slightly lighter and smaller (about 18px).

fixes.problem: The tab labels 'Search' and 'Computer' and their icons are offset by 1–2px. The search icon is bolder than the real one.
fixes.fix: Set the tab labels to 15px weight 400, with 'Search' at weight 500. Use a 1.5px stroke on the search icon. Move the label baseline up 1px so it matches the real y≈30.

fixes.problem: The 'Set up Computer 0/3' banner text is bolder and wider than the real one, and the 'Do anything…' placeholder is wider. The tab labels are off by about 1px.
fixes.fix: Set the banner text to 14.5px weight 500 in #0B6B6B so 'Set up Computer' ends at about x165 and '0/3' sits at x175–197. Set the placeholder to 16px with letter-spacing about -0.1px. Move the tab labels up 1px.

fixes.problem: The button and skip labels are slightly off. The 'Get started' pill is 1px narrower and shorter than the real one, and the text is a touch bold.
fixes.fix: Make the pill x16–395, y702–758 with the label at weight 500, 16px. Keep 'Skip intro' at y794.

summary: Layout is already accurate: every data-el is within 4px, all taps work, and there are no contract errors. The biggest remaining loss is the s07 hero, which shows a dotted texture instead of the meadow photo and a crisp sphere, plus its title and body wrap. After that, fine-tune text weight, size, and letter-spacing across s04, s01 and s10.
